title: alchemilla jugensis
intro: Alchemilla jugensis, commonly known as Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating inflammatory conditions, such as arthritis, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla jugensis are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hemostatic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
